dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric, gradual narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous with no visible structural deviations or bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone characterized by high-intensity pixel reflectance across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, sparse distribution of small dark-pixel specks scattered primarily near the dorsal midline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, distinct vertical linear scar is visible along the posterior central dorsal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Significant longitudinal topological disruption appearing as a shallow groove along the posterior midline corresponding to the visible scar.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear scar is present on the posterior dorsal surface.
